title: 听力挑战 · 讲述错过火车

rounds.speaker: 同事
rounds.line: Why did you miss the morning train today?
rounds.lineCn: 你今天为什么错过了早班火车?

grammar.name: 过去完成时 had done
grammar.note: had + 过去分词表示'过去的过去',在描述错过火车这类先后动作时常用。

options.text: Because my alarm had not gone off.
options.feedback: 闹钟没响发生在错过火车之前,用过去完成时很准确。

options.text: Because I will wake up late.
options.feedback: will 表将来,与过去的错过事件矛盾。

options.text: Because I am running slowly now.
options.feedback: 现在进行时描述此刻,不能解释过去的迟到原因。

rounds.speaker: 同事
rounds.line: What happened when you arrived at the station?
rounds.lineCn: 你到车站时发生了什么?

grammar.name: 过去完成时表先发生
grammar.note: 火车先已离开、后到达车站,先用过去完成时表达更早的动作。

options.text: The train had already left the platform.
options.feedback: 火车离开先于到达,had left 表达先后顺序准确。

options.text: The train is leaving right now.
options.feedback: 现在进行时与过去的场景矛盾。
将来时与已发生的错过事件不符。

rounds.speaker: 朋友
rounds.line: How did you get to work in the end?
rounds.lineCn: 最后你是怎么去上班的?

grammar.name: 过去完成时与一般过去时连用
grammar.note: 描述过去场景时,先发生的动作用过去完成时,后发生的用一般过去时。

options.text: I took a taxi after the train had left.
options.feedback: 先发生 had left,后发生 took,主从时态使用得当。

options.text: I have taken a bus before.
options.feedback: 现在完成时谈泛泛经历,没有回答当天怎么去的。

options.text: I am taking a train now.
options.feedback: 现在进行时与问题时态不符。
